# Vicoco

> Browser-based image compression and conversion with local processing.

## Main resources

- [Free Image Compressor Online](https://vicoco.uk/): Compress and convert images locally in the Vicoco browser editor.
- [Squoosh Batch Image Compressor - Compress Images in Bulk](https://vicoco.uk/compress/squoosh-batch-image-compressor/): Compress, resize, and convert multiple JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and SVG images.

## Workflow

- Add multiple images, a folder, dropped files, or a pasted image.
- Compare image quality and file size in the Vicoco editor.
- Apply format, quality, and resize settings to the complete queue.
- Export processed images together as a ZIP.

## Privacy

- Image processing runs locally in the browser.
- Source images are not uploaded to a processing server.
